usage: The verb 帶 is used when you want to express bringing or carrying something or someone from one place to another.
You can use 帶 to talk about bringing objects, like 帶錢 (bring money), or people, like 帶朋友 (bring friends).
帶 often appears before the object that is being brought, as in 帶手機 (bring a phone).
In casual conversation, 帶 can also imply to include or to take along something by necessity or choice.
